about: SF2 (meta standalone shardfiles, Jake SD1): zone art two or more zones use. Each set names the zones that place it; a set fewer than two zones name belongs in its one zone's repo. A shard names a file by its own URL, /assets/<slug>/<path under content/art>, and the SDK copies it into the shardfile from here. Images only: the cook makes every KTX2 (J525).
